title: Microsoft 365 admin center

signIn.hint: Sign in with an admin of the demo tenant; the account picker can show twice.

nav.note: The left navigation collapses below the admin center's own breakpoint (1024 CSS px). A demo gives the captured variant: { use: 'nav', variant }.

header.note: The top bar compacts (search becomes an icon) between 1097 and 1280 CSS px (the 175% and 150% captures).

tools-grid.note: Agents › Tools grid (Fluent DataGrid): column fitting. Minimums and the space beside the columns were measured at each zoom; the ideal widths are a capture's.

theme.setting: The header's "Switch to Dark Mode" toggle
fallbacks: Fluent v8 writes colors as literals in its CSS: the theme packs carry the literal pairs learned from one screen in both themes, so a color only some screens use can stay
Charts in Reports (images, canvas) keep their colors

notes: No write of a demo has been recorded here yet: the admin center was only read (Agents › Tools, a tool's details, Users).
